gaps.where: Agency area → Client businesses: the Setup column (done of total, Stuck/Setting up/Done badge, note), the All/Stuck/Setting up/Done filter with counts, the header summary, and the setup sheet. Also Agency area → Saved setups: the whole list
gaps.gap: read_onboarding_clients and read_ai_setup_template_list are in SCREEN_READS, but both queries need org.templates.manage. screenReadToolsFor(can) keeps a tool only when can(permission) is true, and for a non-staff permission can() is holds(workspace, p). workspace.permissions comes from private.my_permissions, which reads app.workspace_access only, and org.templates.manage belongs only to org_owner and org_admin. So nobody is ever offered either tool. Unlike SCREEN_ACTIONS, SCREEN_READS has no offeredTo override. get_agency_area doesn't call onboarding.clients or ai_setup_template.list either. The Assistant can't say which client businesses are stuck, who owns them, when they last signed in or whether a reminder went today, and it can't list Saved setups. No test checks that an org owner is offered these reads.
gaps.fix: Fixed: SCREEN_READ_WAYS in screen-reads.ts offers read_onboarding_clients and read_ai_setup_template_list on workspace.update; the kernel still checks org.templates.manage on the organization, whose id is put on server-side. The worker test checks an owner is offered both and a member is not. Anyone who isn’t one of the agency’s owners or admins is told who can (agency_only), for these and every agency change, never that the agency isn’t there.

gaps.where: Agency area → Migrations: the Connected list, every move with its status, and each move's page (Where it lands, What to bring, Bringing it across, Done, Pause/Carry on, Try N again)
gaps.gap: Every Assistant path to migrations goes through the business door. The query() helper always adds workspaceId = ctx.workspaceId, so get_settings 'migrations' reads migration.list as that business. read_migration_get, read_migration_review_queue and every do_migration_* tool use scopedInput, which strips workspaceId, and inputOf, which puts the current business back. In the workspace door, resolveScope sets orgRole: null. migrationAccess then returns onlyWorkspaceId = this business even for an agency owner. Moves that reach no business yet, such as a fresh agency-wide move at Where it lands, are invisible, and so are moves that reach only other businesses. Agency connections that aren't tied to this business are invisible too. Pause, Carry on and Try again on a multi-business move are refused with 'only your agency can pause it', even when the agency's own owner asks. The agency page (/app/org/<id>/migrations) uses the organization door and sees everything. migration.list isn't a screen read; the Assistant reaches it only through get_settings.
gaps.fix: Fixed: read_migration_get, read_migration_review_queue and every do_migration_* tool take wholeAgency. scopeIds in tools-screen-reads.ts then sends only the organization id, after account.me shows the person is one of the agency’s owners or admins (else agency_only), so the kernel checks org.migrations.manage. get_agency_area lists every move and connection through the organization’s door.

gaps.where: Templates → Push… → Match details: per business, each detail matched by name where possible, with a picker for each detail ('Leave for them to pick' or one of the business's stages, tags, calendars or people)
gaps.gap: One claim is wrong: a business pushed to for the first time does get details matched by name. workflow_template.install runs effectiveMapping(), which uses suggestMapping for any key that was never mapped, so the server matches by name the same way the screen does. What is real: push_to_client_businesses has no `mappings` input, so the agency can't choose a detail for one business ('use Estimate sent for Bayou') or deliberately leave one for the business to pick. The Assistant can't read another business's stages, tags, calendars or people. The card also overstates what is left. Its toPick list names every placeholder not in the stored mapping ('Each business picks its own …; its draft can’t publish until it has'), including ones the install will match by name.
gaps.fix: Fixed: push_to_client_businesses matches each detail in each business as the install does (effectiveMapping on that business’s workflow.catalogs, read as the person), shows a line per business and its choices, takes matches (an id from those choices, or null to leave it), and sends that business’s whole mapping on Confirm. The left-to-pick note comes from the computed mapping.

gaps.where: Agency area → Knowledge packs: each row's '12 FAQs and 4 facts · version N · description', the per-business progress line ('Bayou Plumbing Co.: 3 accepted, 9 waiting, 1 rejected'), Archived (n), and the Edit sheet's items (kind, question or title, answer or body)
gaps.gap: get_agency_area returns only each pack's id, name, item count and version. It leaves out the description, the items themselves (kind, title, body, tags), each business's pending, accepted and rejected counts, and archivedAt, though knowledge_pack.list returns all of these. It calls knowledge_pack.list without includeArchived, so archived packs never appear. The Assistant can't restore one because it never sees the id. KnowledgePackUpdateInput.items replaces the whole list, and do_knowledge_pack_update's description ('Change a starter pack’s name, description or items…') doesn't say so. The Assistant can't read the existing items, so adding one FAQ would wipe the rest.
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_agency_area lists archived packs too, with description, items count and each business’s accepted, waiting and rejected; packId gives every item. do_knowledge_pack_update’s about says items replaces the whole list.

gaps.where: Settings → Migrations / Agency area → Migrations, Connect a CRM dialog: GoHighLevel is connected by pasting a Private integration token (In GoHighLevel: Settings → Private Integrations → create one, tick the read access, copy the token) and the Location ID (Settings → Business Profile), then Connect
gaps.gap: SIGN_IN_SOURCES is empty, so GoHighLevel connects only by pasting a Private integration token and the Location ID, and the dialog's button says Connect. The Assistant's migrations handover still says 'Pick the system you are coming from and sign in there', with the why 'you sign in to the old system yourself'. The NEVER reason for migration.connect says 'signing in at the CRM the business is leaving'. No Assistant words mention Private Integrations or the Location ID. Keeping migration.connect as a never is still right, because the token goes straight to HandsFreeOS.
gaps.fix: Fixed: the migrations handover already walks through the private token and Location ID; NEVER_FOR_THE_ASSISTANT[migration.connect] now says the token is pasted straight to HandsFreeOS, and settings_help says connecting the CRM they’re leaving.

gaps.where: Client businesses → a business's Setup → setup sheet: 'Email <first name> a reminder'
gaps.gap: OnboardingRemindInput is {organizationId, workspaceId}, and workspaceId is the client business to remind. scopedInput strips workspaceId, and inputOf sets it to ctx.workspaceId, so do_onboarding_remind can only remind the owners of the business the person is asking in. Asked from the agency's own business, it is refused with onboarding_no_owner, because owners who are org members are excluded. Severity drops to medium: the agency owner can still ask from inside the client's business.
gaps.fix: Fixed: ScreenAction.forBusiness on onboarding.remind adds businessId to the model’s input. scopeIds checks it is one of the agency’s businesses (account.me) and that the person is the agency’s owner or admin before putting it on as workspaceId; the card names the business.

gaps.where: Agency area → Templates: the Installed in chips (v2 ✓, v1 ↻, ⚠ couldn’t install: <error>), Who’s behind ('Summit Roofing is 1 behind', 'Bayou couldn’t install', 'Installing…'), the description or 'N details to match'. In the template editor: Installed in, each row's '<n> behind', 'Couldn’t install: <lastError>' and 'Their copy' link. On Client businesses: '3 templates · 1 behind'
gaps.gap: In overview mode, get_agency_area returns only inBusinesses = installs.total. It drops installs.installed, pending, failed and behind, and the template's description, though TemplateSummary already types them. In detail mode, each business gets status, a behind flag and stillToPick. It drops installedVersion (so not how far behind), lastError and workflowId, and the overview's business list has no per-business template count or behind count. 'Which businesses are behind?' takes one call per template, 'Why couldn’t Summit install it?' has no answer, and the Assistant can't link to a business's copy.
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_agency_area gives each template’s description, installs (installed, installing, couldn’t install, behind) and Who’s behind, each business’s template tally, and in a template’s detail each business’s version, versions behind, its install error and a link to its copy.

gaps.where: A business's Workflows list: 'Review update' on a copy of an agency template, and the Update available dialog (What changes in version N, Your changes stay, These changes of yours no longer fit, pick X in Checks, Not now / Apply the update)
gaps.gap: A business's preview of an agency template update and its Apply the update go through the worker routes /v1/workflows/template-update and /template-update/apply, which run planTemplateUpdate and workflow_template.apply_update as a system actor. Neither goes through /v1/commands, so the coverage test never sees them. No Assistant tool previews or applies an update. get_workflow returns no source.template (name, installedVersion, latestVersion, updateAvailable), though WorkflowSummaryOut carries it, and the context's workflow list carries nothing about it either.
gaps.fix: Fixed: by the workflows step, review_template_update and apply_template_update (tools-workflow.ts).

gaps.where: Settings → Migrations and Agency area → Migrations: the move's own page and its buttons (Save and choose what to bring, Save what to bring, Bring it across, Pause / Carry on, Try N again, Same as … / Somebody new, Look at the old system)
gaps.gap: migrations.canChange is [] and the area's only handover is 'move a business over'. The prompt lists 'moving in from another system' among the things that need the person and go to settings_help, and settings_help's own description says so too. Yet do_migration_create, scan, select, map_scopes, start, pause, resume, retry and resolve_merge are all offered, and docs/operations.md says the Assistant does a move 'from making it and choosing what comes to starting, pausing and carrying on'. onScreen lists only 'Connect a CRM' and 'Connected', so the Assistant can't name the move page's steps or buttons, and the prompt forbids naming buttons that aren't listed.
gaps.fix: Fixed: settings-map migrations lists each move, its status words, the move’s page and its buttons (Save and choose what to bring, Save what to bring, Bring it across, Pause, Carry on, Try N again, Same as, Somebody new, Take it back, Delete this move) and Agency area → Migrations. settings_help says connecting the CRM they’re leaving.

gaps.where: Agency area side menu: Client businesses, Templates, Knowledge packs, Saved setups, Migrations; and what each page has
gaps.gap: The Agency area place's onScreen lists 'Client businesses, Templates, Knowledge packs, Migrations' and leaves out Saved setups, which the agency side menu shows. The prompt forbids naming a place, tab or button that isn't listed, and no Assistant source mentions 'Saved setups', 'Save from a business', '… a reminder', 'Open setup', 'Open their workspace' or 'Do it for them'. The entry leaves out the Client businesses Setup column and filter, the setup sheet's buttons, the template editor's Publish, Installed in and Versions, and packs' Archived (n). canChange lists only seeing things and pushing, though the tools also create, save-as, rename, publish and edit templates, create and update packs, save, rename and delete setups, remind, add a business and add an owner.
gaps.fix: Fixed: the Agency area place lists Saved setups and what each page has (Setup and its filters, the setup sheet’s buttons, a template’s Publish, Push…, Installed in and Versions, Archived (n), Save from a business, Rename, Remove), how to remind a client and save a setup, and everything the tools change there.

gaps.where: The whole agency area (/app/org/<orgId>/…): there is no Ask HandsFreeOS there
gaps.gap: AssistantProvider and AssistantPanel are mounted only in apps/web/src/app/app/w/[workspaceId]/layout.tsx. The agency shell (/app/org/<id>/…) doesn't mount them, so on Templates, Knowledge packs, Saved setups, Client businesses or a migration's page there's no Ask HandsFreeOS. EVERY_PAGE tells the Assistant that 'Ask HandsFreeOS … which is you' is at the top of the side menu on every page, and the Agency area place doesn't say to ask from a business. From a business the Assistant reaches only that business's organization (ctx.organizationId), so the switcher's other agencies are out of reach.
gaps.fix: Left open: mounting Ask HandsFreeOS in the agency shell needs its own page record, consent and a business to run in, which is more than this step. The Agency area place now says to ask from any of the agency’s businesses, and EVERY_PAGE says the panel is on every business page.

gaps.where: Template editor: Publish, disabled with 'Fix the red items in Checks first' while Checks has errors
gaps.gap: The editor's Publish is disabled while templateIssues(draft) has errors ('Fix the red items in Checks first'). workflow_template.publish never checks templateIssues, so do_workflow_template_publish publishes a template the screen won't. push_to_client_businesses then pushes it, since it checks only latestVersion and archivedAt, and every business gets a draft with broken steps. get_agency_area does return checksToFix, but nothing stops the publish.
gaps.fix: Fixed: workflow_template.publish refuses while templateIssues has an error (rule template_has_errors), naming the first and where to fix it, so the screen and the Assistant share one check. A core test covers it.

gaps.where: Saved setups → Save from a business: the Business picker
gaps.gap: AiSetupTemplateSaveInput.workspaceId is the business whose answers are saved. scopedInput strips it and inputOf replaces it with ctx.workspaceId, so the Assistant can save only the current business's setup. 'Save Bayou’s setup as Home services' works only when asked from inside Bayou, while the screen has a Business picker. Severity is low because asking from Bayou is a workaround.
gaps.fix: Fixed: ScreenAction.forBusiness on ai_setup_template.save adds businessId, checked to be the agency’s before it is put on as workspaceId; the card names the business.

gaps.where: A migration's page: 'Take it back' (in the Brought across card, and in Delete this move)
gaps.gap: migration.start's card warning says 'Taking it all back is Roll back, on the Migrations page'. The web app has no button called Roll back. The button is 'Take it back', and it is on the move's own page (in the Brought across card, and in Delete this move), not on the Migrations list. docs/operations.md:6970 repeats 'Roll back'.
gaps.fix: Fixed: migration.start’s warning says Take it back, on the move’s own page, and docs/operations.md says Take it back.

gaps.where: Template editor → Versions: 'Version N · <publisher> · <date>' with up to 4 change lines and '…and N more'
gaps.gap: workflow_template.get returns versions (version, diff, publishedBy, createdAt). The worker's TemplateGet type doesn't even declare them, and get_agency_area's template detail returns none. 'What changed in version 3?' and 'Who published it?' have no answer. The severity is lowered to low because this is history, not something the person acts on.
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_agency_area’s template detail gives its versions: who published each, when, and up to 10 changes with how many more.

gaps.where: Client businesses setup sheet: step titles, 'Do it for them' links to the client's own screen, 'Open setup' and 'Open their workspace'
gaps.gap: This only matters once agency-1 is fixed. onboarding.clients returns each business's full steps array as raw OnboardingStepOut: key, group, mustDo, state, since and note. It has no stepTitle or stepWords and no stepPath link, while the setup sheet shows words.title and links 'Do it for them' to stepPath. The input is only {organizationId}, with no filter or page, so for a larger agency the answer passes the 16,000-character cut and the 'ask for less' note asks for something the query can't do.
gaps.fix: Fixed: clientsRead in setup-screens.ts gives each business’s setup in words, its open steps with titles and Do it for them links, Open the setup and Open their workspace; onboarding.clients takes group and businessId filters.

gaps.where: Agency area pages and their links: the Templates page, a template's editor, Knowledge packs, Saved setups, and each business's Open
gaps.gap: The organization id is never in the prompt or context. placesText doesn't render paths, and the Agency area path is '/app/org/[orgId]/templates'. get_agency_area returns no links and no org id. Only the commit hrefs of edit_template_steps and push are links, and those are bare paths. Asked for the link to the agency's Templates page, one template, the packs or saved-setups page, or a business, the Assistant can only guess.
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_agency_area gives links to each agency page, each template, each business and each business’s copy of a template, with the organization’s id put on server-side.

gaps.where: A migration's page: Take it back ('Take back everything this migration put here? Customers you already had are never deleted.')
gaps.gap: Keeping migration.rollback from the Assistant is settled. It is risk 4, and the owner's decision in docs/operations.md:6970 says 'Roll back and deleting a move stay the person’s', so the suggestion to offer it as a confirm is refuted. What is real: the NEVER reason ('taking back everything a move from another CRM brought, for good') is false. The screen and the command say the records are put away, not gone, that customers already there are never deleted, and that only Delete this move finishes them off.
gaps.fix: Fixed: the NEVER reason for migration.rollback now says it puts away what the move brought, that Delete this move finishes them off, and that the person presses Take it back. It stays never.

gaps.where: Migrations: the status badge words (Needs a look, Ready to set up, Bringing it across, Keeping up with the old system…), and the 'N things left for you' links to each task's screen
gaps.gap: migration.list and migration.get return the raw status (needs_attention, scanned, transition…). The screen's words ('Needs a look', 'Ready to set up', 'Keeping up with the old system') live only in apps/web/src/lib/agency/migration-words.ts STATUS_WORDS (lines 65-84, not 145-164). The tasks carry settingsPath as a bare business-relative path ('/settings/payments') plus workspaceId, while the screen links to /app/w/<workspaceId><path>. The Assistant can't name the status as shown or give the link.
gaps.fix: Fixed: MIGRATION_STATUS_WORDS moved to @hfos/core (migrations/words.ts), the web imports it, and the Assistant’s migration reads add statusLabel and each task’s link.

gaps.where: Templates → Save a workflow as a template: Business picker, then Workflow picker
gaps.gap: workflow_template.create_from_workflow takes any workflowId in the organization: the handler joins workflows to workspaces by organizationId. The Assistant can list and read workflows only in the business it's asked in (the context's workflow.list and get_workflow, through query(), which adds ctx.workspaceId). So it can't find another client's workflow to save as a template. Asking from that business works around it.
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_agency_area with a businessId, checked to be the agency’s, lists that business’s workflows, read as the person there.

gaps.where: Knowledge packs → New pack / Edit → Copy from a business (pick a business, tick its published FAQs, articles and facts, Add N items)
gaps.gap: The pack editor's Copy from a business reads knowledge_item.list for the picked businessId. The Assistant's list_knowledge_items always reads the current business through query(), so it can fill a pack (do_knowledge_pack_create or update with items) only from the business it's asked in.
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_agency_area with a businessId gives that business’s published knowledge (kind, title, body, tags), ready to pass as items.

gaps.where: Template editor → Test (Simulate: steps walked with sample details, nothing sent)
gaps.gap: The template editor's Test is a simulation that runs only in the browser (apps/web/src/lib/agency/simulate.ts, 'use client'). The Assistant has no tool for it. get_agency_area gives the steps in words but can't walk them with sample details or show which branch is taken.
gaps.fix: Left open: the template Test walks the steps in the browser (apps/web/src/lib/agency/simulate.ts, with the web’s sample values and test hook); moving the walk into @hfos/core is a step of its own.
